notes: Official BVAL sheet titled "BVAL Boys Basketball / 2025 - 26 Team Standings", linked from bval.org/standings. Varsity order is the sheet's own "Place".
Records only: the sheet has Overall and League Record per school and no points, goals or tiebreak data, so none are stored or computed.
Records are written as the sheet prints them (W-L), without the spaces around each hyphen; the sport has no ties, so t is 0.

Places are the sheet's, ties included: Christopher and Westmont (2); Pioneer and Leigh (5); Piedmont Hills and Lincoln (3); Sobrato and Silver Creek (3). A tied place is stored as printed, and the next place skips.

The 2025-26 divisions are the sheet's (Mt. Hamilton; Santa Teresa North, "Santa Teresa - North" in the sheet; Santa Teresa South, "Santa Teresa - South" in the sheet; West Valley), not 2026-27's in lib/registry/basketball/bval.ts. Santa Teresa North and Santa Teresa South are divisions BVAL no longer has (seasonAlignment.pastDivisions). Santa Teresa and Almaden Valley did not exist in 2025-26. Filed elsewhere in 2026-27: Branham (Santa Teresa North), Independence (Santa Teresa North), Piedmont Hills (Santa Teresa North), Lincoln (Santa Teresa North), Prospect (Santa Teresa North), Mt. Pleasant (Santa Teresa North), Leland (Santa Teresa South), Live Oak (Santa Teresa South), Sobrato (Santa Teresa South), Silver Creek (Santa Teresa South), Gilroy (Santa Teresa South), Oak Grove (Santa Teresa South), Overfelt (West Valley). The registry is not changed; the page says these teams moved.

JV is stored from the JV Place and JV Record columns, ordered on the JV place (the sheet's row order among equal places); tied JV places: Westmont and Santa Teresa (3); Live Oak and Silver Creek (2); Gunderson and Andrew Hill (3). No JV row for James Lick: its JV record is not a record ("n/a" or empty).
No all-league awards: this sport's BVAL all-league documents are not transcribed, so every division's awards are null.

notes: PAL boys basketball 2025-26, from pal.smcoe.org: the standings linked from https://pal.smcoe.org/standings. Rows are in the league's own order; nothing is recomputed.

The varsity tables are the PDF linked as "Basketball - Boys VAR" from pal.smcoe.org/standings ("2026 BOYS VARSITY BAY BASKETBALL STANDINGS" and "… OCEAN …"); the JV tables are the one linked as "Basketball - Boys JV" (https://drive.google.com/file/d/11SLkmEObL7BEzu2UjY1JEr4aOG0EEqGq/view).
Each table prints Rank, School, Win and Loss: no overall record, so every overallRecord is null. Rows keep the PDF's rank, which repeats for teams ranked level (2, 2, 4).

Division membership is 2025-26's: Burlingame, Carlmont, Half Moon Bay, Jefferson, Menlo-Atherton, Sequoia and Terra Nova in the Bay; Aragon, Capuchino, El Camino, Hillsdale, Mills, Oceana, San Mateo, South San Francisco, Westmoor and Woodside in the Ocean. In 2026-27 Aragon, Hillsdale and Woodside play in the Bay, and Jefferson and Terra Nova in the Ocean.
Oceana played in the PAL's Ocean in 2025-26 and is in the PSAL for 2026-27, which this build has covered since 2026-11-25 (`formerMembers`): its rows link its team page.
The JV Ocean table prints Capuchino at 6-5, eleven games where every other team played twelve; it is kept as printed.
Only standings are stored: the PAL's all-league teams are not transcribed.

provenance.extraction: Standings: pdftotext -layout. All-league awards: By hand, from pdftotext -layout of each PDF; each row is [player, school, position, year] as printed.
notes: SCVAL boys basketball, from scval.com/standings. Rows are in the PDF's own "SCHOOL by finish" order; nothing is recomputed, since the PDF carries no game-level data.
The PDF's "Overall record" column is empty, so every overallRecord is null.
Division membership is the 2025-26 PDF's, which is not the 2026-27 alignment; the page says which teams moved.
School spellings are the documents' own ("Mt. View", "Monta VIsta"); `slug` is the join key.
Grades are stored as 9-12 whatever the document wrote ("Jr", "Junior", "Soph", "Frosh", "11").
An overall award is stored as "Player, School, Position, Grade" from the document's four cells. Two players named for one award are two entries under the same title.
Records are W-L: a basketball game cannot end level, so the PDF prints no ties and t is stored as 0.
Each all-league document names one MVP and a first, second and third team; there is no honorable mention.
JV membership is varsity's in both divisions.

notes: WBAL boys basketball 2025-26, from hs.wbalsports.org: the standings linked from https://hs.wbalsports.org/history.html. Rows are in the league's own order; nothing is recomputed.
The page is "2025-26 WBAL Boys Basketball Standings", linked from hs.wbalsports.org/history.html: one varsity table and one JV table.
The page prints a place for the first of two teams ranked level and leaves the next row's blank; the blank row takes the place above it (Menlo and Pinewood, both 4-6, 5th).
The JV table leaves both Crystal's and Harker's places blank, below Priory's 4th; both are 1-5, so both are stored as 5th, level.

Eastside College Prep and Pinewood are in no JV table.
School spellings are the page's own ("Crystal"); `slug` is the join key. Only standings are stored: the WBAL's all-league teams are not transcribed.

notes: WCAL boys basketball 2025-26, from wcalsports.org: the standings linked from https://wcalsports.org/standings/. Rows are in the league's own order; nothing is recomputed.

The standings PDF is the WCAL's 2025-2026 archive, linked as "2025-2026" from wcalsports.org/standings/: "WCAL MEN'S BASKETBALL FINAL STANDINGS", varsity of February 17, 2026 ("WCAL CHAMPION – ARCHBISHOP RIORDAN") and junior varsity of February 18, 2026 ("WCAL CHAMPION – SAINT IGNATIUS").

The PDF prints no place column: each table is in its own order, and `place` is the row's position in it. Sacred Heart Cathedral and Saint Francis are both 1-13 in the varsity table, in that order, so they are 7th and 8th.
League is the PDF's League Wins and Losses columns, overall its Season columns.
The JV table prints Archbishop Riordan at 6-4, Bellarmine at 7-6, Saint Francis at 6-7 and Sacred Heart Cathedral at 1-12, fewer than fourteen league games; each is kept as printed.
The PDF's freshman tables are not stored: the archive has varsity and JV only. Only standings are stored: the WCAL's all-league teams are not transcribed.
